answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The signal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jade. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
